article.title: 'The President of the United States Is Mentally Unwell': Deranged Trump Posts AI Slop of Iran Bombing
article.summary: US President Donald Trump published a string of unhinged posts to his social media platform overnight and into Monday morning, including an artificial intelligence-generated video attempting to depict American forces bombing Kharg Island—Iran's primary oil export terminal.The post, which drew mockery from Iranian officials and alarm from observers concerned about Trump's increasingly erratic behavior, came after US forces attacked Larak Island, which is located hundreds of miles east of Kharg in the Strait of Hormuz."Kharg Island being blown to smithereens!!!" Trump wrote in the caption of his post. article.title: Trump was sending message to Iran with Kharg Island post, says Vance
article.summary: Aug 31 (Reuters) - U.S. President Donald Trump was sending a message to Iran with his social media post about Iran's energy hub of Kharg Island being blown to smithereens, Vice President JD Vance said on Monday."The president likes to switch it up on social media a little bit. He would be the first to say he doesn't make announcements about military actions on social media, but I think that he's sending a message to the Iranians," Vance said when asked about Trump's post.

article.title: Iran still wants negotiated end to war, president says after exchanges of fire
article.summary: DUBAI: Iran is still seeking a negotiated solution to its conflict with the U.S., President Masoud Pezeshkian said on Monday, a day after the two countries resumed hostilities for the first time since late July, driving oil prices up more than 3.5%.Pezeshkian’s comments also came after U.S. President Donald Trump posted an AI-generated video clip that he said showed Iran’s oil hub Kharg Island being destroyed. There was no evidence of any such attack and a U.S. official said on Monday the military had not targeted Kharg Island in overnight strikes. An Iranian official dismissed Trump’s post as “laughable”.U.S. forces on Sunday struck two Iranian launchers on Iran’s Larak Island, some 660 km (410 miles) east of Kharg, a U.S. official said, prompting Iran to strike two U.S. bases in Jordan, according to Iranian media.Two people were killed and others were injured in the attack on Larak Island, Iran’sIRNAnews agency quoted the local governor as saying on Monday.The return to hostilitie...

article.title: Vance says Trump Kharg post was 'message' to Iran
article.summary: Vance says Trump Kharg post was 'message' to IranUSVice President JD Vance has said that President Donald Trump was sending a message to Iran when he posted an AI-generated video that appeared to show the US military blowing up oil facilities onIran'sKharg Island earlier on Monday."The president likes to switch it up on social media a little bit," Vance said when asked about Trump's post at a press conference."He would be the first to say he doesn't make announcements about military actions on social media, but I think that he's sending a message to the Iranians," he added.Earlier on Monday, Hamid Bovard, the chief executive of the National Iranian Oil Company, denied that the US had destroyed oil facilities on Kharg.
